news.title: The Sorting Line: recycling work
news.summary: Work the belt at the recycling warehouse. Pull items into the right boxes, carry full boxes in and get paid at the baler.
news.body: A new solo-friendly job at the recycling warehouse. Grab items off the moving belt into the right box; a box fills at 20 and you carry it over to turn it in. The belt speeds up as you sort. Half-filled boxes and pay waiting at the baler are kept if the server restarts, and Esc no longer opens the pause map while you work. Test a full shift, carrying boxes and getting paid.

news.title: Window washing, Wildlife Control and farming
news.summary: Three new civilian jobs: ride a cradle up a skyscraper, track and dart loose animals, or farm with friends.
news.body: Window washers ride a cradle up and down a tower facade and squeegee each pane full-screen. Wildlife Control sends you out in a Vapid kennel truck to track animals by paw prints, dart them, carry them back in your arms and release them. Farming adds co-op contracts and tractor plowing. Jobs are handed out by talking to the boss: conversations are now cinematic close-ups with a clipboard map of job areas, and Esc ends a conversation instantly. Test each job solo and with a friend.

news.title: Crafting benches and skills
news.summary: Benches with blueprints, levels and perks. Lean over the bench, pick a recipe and craft in one click. Track your progress in the new Skills phone app.
news.body: Crafting happens at real benches: walk up, lean over the worktop and the menu appears on the table. Recipes show every missing material ("need 2 more"), favourites stay on top and crafting is one click with a queue. Crafting has 20 levels with perks, and higher levels open more recipes and benches you can place at home. Several people can watch someone craft, but one person uses a bench at a time. The new Skills app on the phone shows your levels. Test crafting, levelling up, placing a home bench and walking away mid-craft.

news.title: Casino and arcade upgrades
news.body: The casino floor is open for testing with roulette upgrades, pachinko and other fixes, and other players' chip stacks are lighter on performance. Arcade machines got an art pass, fixes for every game and fewer stuck cabinets. Report any game that freezes, pays wrong or does not save.

news.title: Vehicles: new controls and car audio
news.body: Vehicle controls are redesigned with movable Clearly layouts and ignition controls, and open straight from the radial menu. The aux cord now plugs into the glovebox AUX slot and keeps playing near a running car, and the vehicle HUD shows what is playing. The stock GTA radio and radio wheel are gone. Spawn drop-offs drive smoothly to the curb. Test the controls, aux music with passengers and a fresh spawn.

news.title: City, sound and quality of life
news.body: Voices are muffled through closed doors and walls (radio and calls are unchanged). Every character now has one permanent player ID, shown on character select. New gun sounds, smaller gun textures and a performance pass should mean smoother frames. The HUD lets you choose when each bar shows, and the compass no longer sticks. Phone calls peek in instead of taking over the screen, you can copy and paste message text, and Esc or M closes the phone from any app. Female characters get 26 new hairstyles. Placeable beer cases, dumpster diving by torchlight and new Vinewood and hill signs are in. Stock GTA fire and ambulance responses are off.

news.title: World: quieter streets and new scenes
news.body: Ambient traffic and pedestrians are down by 80%, and NPC drivers no longer react strangely to emergency lights. NPC cars and dumpsters no longer have random loot. Staff can place grouped scenes such as hospital staff, coffee breaks and clipboards from a catalog of 46 peds and 26 formations. Dropdowns in shops, restaurants, clothing and scenes now open a Clearly list. Check performance, hospital staff and any floating or misplaced peds.

news.title: Homes and Realty: own any house
news.summary: Buy, mortgage, rent or rent-to-own map houses through a realtor, then furnish the whole house.
news.body: Realtors list houses from the phone Realty app, with photos, drafts and chat. Everyone can browse listings on a list or map. Owners place a wall tablet and furnish the whole house without invisible walls. Owners pay for furniture, keyholders get storage, and Left/Right arrows rotate pieces. Buyable wardrobes open saved outfits, a spawn mat sets your Arrivals spawn, and houses can have garages. Weekly tax and seizure are in place. Apartment doors and the Leave option behave better. Clearly garage terminals show vehicle photos, and config-driven elevators are added. Test buying, rent payments, furnishing, keys and wardrobes.

news.title: Phone: camera, Gallery, Bank, Bills and 911
news.summary: Rebuilt camera and selfies, a Gallery for each handset, a new Bank, Bills and 911, plus a fix for the phone getting stuck.
news.body: The phone camera has a movable selfie lens, a first-person rear camera, lock screen shortcuts and you can walk or drive with it out. Gallery matches your handset. The Bank app adds savings accounts and a weekly in/out panel. Bills shows what you owe and uses slide-to-pay. 911 has hold-to-SOS, report chat, live tracking and public alerts. Maps now has place details, directions and waypoints shared with the game map. Services is the job app with rosters, hiring and business stats. Calls include speakerphone and stronger voice filters: M lowers the phone, Backspace hangs up. The phone clock uses in-game time, and a stuck phone screen now recovers. Test photos and albums, calls with a friend, payments and 911.

news.title: Arcade: new machines
news.body: New arcade games include Crypt Survivors, Grand Theft Survivors and Hewn, plus two-player and two-screen machines and saving fixes. Try them and report scores that do not save or two-player sessions that break.

news.title: Police, MDT and EMS
news.summary: Reports are rebuilt as guided steps with drag-and-drop people. The MDT adds Jail, Photos and a command Log, and EMS treatments are server-timed.
news.body: MDT reports use scenario templates, auto-written drafts, drag-and-drop role boxes, evidence and photo panels, a full-size charge picker, Booking and edit history. New tabs cover jail sentences (cadets can view only), a command activity log, shared police photos, case chat and @ officer mentions. The photo viewer was also fixed. EMS gets its own patient care report, server-timed field treatments and bed stays, and duty-checked lockers. Searching a downed player also works reliably now. Test a full arrest-to-booking report and an EMS call from start to finish.

news.title: Inventory: drop, place and throw items
news.body: Held items can be aimed, placed on the ground or thrown, and they bounce and slide like bags. Items without their own model drop as a small bag. Stacks and item details are kept when you drop or throw. Losing your last phone or radio ends its call or channel. ATMs only work at recorded locations, and the withdrawal limit is higher. Test throwing, picking up and splitting stacks with a second player.

news.title: Vehicles, crashes and combat
news.body: PDM sells one unified catalog of installed civilian cars, with photos and better performance stats in the preview. Crashes no longer black out the screen, and shake scales from small bumps to big impacts with softer injuries. First-person recoil is much lower, and combat no longer locks you into action-mode movement. Left Alt goes to the siren in emergency cars. Test buying a car, crashes at different speeds and first-person shooting.

news.title: Characters: login, clothing and Fitcheck
news.body: Your saved body now loads before you spawn, and login keeps your health. The creator no longer registers a duplicate character after a slow reply. The downed blackout delay is gone. Clothing panels use the shared frost, and saved outfits show as private Fitcheck drafts before you sign up. English is now a nationality option. Reconnect a few times and check your look, health and spawn.

news.title: Server testing and launcher news
news.body: Use the server testing panel to record what works, what fails, and clips. These updates need real in-game testing after the server pulls main and restarts. News refreshes when you reopen the launcher, so future news edits do not need a reinstall.
